name: Magic Weapon
effect: +1 to attack and damage. Counts as magic and silver.

name: Potion of Giant Strength
effect: +2 melee attack and damage for 6 turns.

name: Scroll
effect: One random spell of level 1 to 3, single cast by any caster.

name: Lantern of the Drowned
effect: Blue flame burns 24 turns without oil and shows invisible things.
drawback: Water within 30 ft rises an inch each turn it is lit.

name: Blade of the First Orc
drawback: Howls when drawn: every monster on the level makes a noise check.

name: Mantle of Ashes
effect: The wearer is immune to fire.
drawback: The wearer's own touch chars paper and wood.

name: Ring of the Shut Door
effect: Once per day, Hold Portal without a slot.
drawback: The wearer cannot open any door another person has closed.

name: Idol of Small Mercies
effect: Once per day, a full Cure Light Wounds on a touch.
drawback: It remembers each name, and one day it will ask for something.

name: Wand of the Unseen Hand
effect: 3 charges a day, each a Magic Missile.
drawback: Each charge used leaves one of the wielder's fingers numb until sleep.
